summary: I am working on whether skipping layers to make a language model run faster also removes the layers that make it refuse harmful requests, and how much speed I can gain before the refusals drop.
I am working on whether a replicated approximate-nearest-neighbour index silently diverges in search quality across replicas under node failure, and whether that divergence persists after recovery.

I am working on whether neural architecture search controllers actually beat budget-matched random-search restarts, and whether a scaffold's contribution can be audited mechanically before publication.
